title: Embroider
summary: EMBROID'ER, verb transitive To border with ornamental needle-work, or figures; to adorn with raised figures of needle-work; as cloth, stuffs or muslin. Thou shalt embroider the coat of fine line. Exod

inlines.v: EMBROID'ER, verb transitive To border with ornamental needle-work, or figures; to adorn with raised figures of needle-work; as cloth, stuffs or muslin. Thou shalt embroider the coat of fine line. Exodus 28:39.
